stages.name: basic_nouns
stages.description: Learning names for things in the world
sentences: the cat sits on the mat
the dog runs in the park
the house has a door and a window
food and water are needed for life
the tree grows in the garden
the book is on the table
the child plays with the dog
the sun shines in the day and the moon at night
the mother and father love the child
the road goes to the house

stages.name: action_verbs
stages.description: Learning words for actions and events
sentences: the child runs and plays in the garden
we eat food and drink water to live
i see the cat and hear the dog
the teacher helps the child learn
we build houses and grow trees
the bird flies and the fish swims
open the door and close the window
the sun gives light and heat to the world
the child finds the book and reads it
the mother teaches the child to speak

stages.name: adjectives
stages.description: Learning words that describe and qualify
sentences: the big dog is strong and fast
the small cat is beautiful and clean
hot food is good but cold food is bad
the happy child plays with the new toy
the old house is safe but the new road is dangerous
it is hard to find true friends
the right answer is easy if you think
a long road takes a slow walk
the high tree gives clean air
real knowledge is better than fake news

stages.name: abstract_concepts
sentences: time changes everything in life
love and hope give meaning to life
knowledge and wisdom come from learning
justice and freedom are important to people
science seeks truth through reason and logic
art and music express beauty and emotion
language helps us share knowledge and memory
history teaches us about the past and the future
the mind thinks and the soul feels
peace is better than war because life is precious

stages.name: relationships
stages.description: Learning how concepts connect and relate
sentences: because the sun shines the flowers grow
i think therefore i am
however hard the task we must try
although the road is long we walk together
the cause and effect are connected through time
the part is inside the whole
the same truth can have different meanings
before the storm the air is still
knowledge comes from both study and experience
all life needs water and none can live without it

stages.name: technical
sentences: a computer program processes data through algorithms
a function takes input and produces output
memory stores data for the system to use
a network connects computers together
energy and force govern the physical world
atoms form molecules which build all matter
cells contain genes that drive evolution
science uses experiments to test theory with evidence
mathematics uses numbers and equations to model reality
probability and statistics help us understand data
